title: 第七章 缘由第章 乘风御剑诀
content_zh:
武道一途，不进则退；
虽然淬元功可以说是全民修行的，但并不是年纪越大的人，实力会随着慢慢变强。
相反，对于没有上过武道大学，选择百行百业的普通人来说，他们实力最强的那会儿也就是在高考前了
再往后，不管是上大学还是参加工作哪里来的时间和精力再去修行武道？
就算有时间，也有那个心，但武道的修行还是挺费钱的；
最起码，就连吃的都比较多所以基本上没考上武道大学的人都会放弃修行。
周哲的父母就是这种情况，所以黄波和苗俊丝毫不担心男人能够伤害到楚元；
他们也讨厌这种胡搅蛮缠的人，可毕竟有一层老师的身份在，不好亲自出手
女人晃了晃发昏的脑袋，一边脸像发面馒头一般肿起，怨毒的看向三人；
这次楚元掌握好了力量，这才没让她的脑袋像西瓜一样爆开。
她果然也不消停，只是不敢再凑上前来，而是掏出手机，一秒变脸；
一把鼻涕一把泪的开始哭诉
“都看看！都看看啊！
晨阳一中，简直就是一个土匪窝！
他们把我儿子腿打断了还不够，还打我一个女人！
就连我老公的手都被他们打断了，作为一个普通人，难道我们就注定要这样被人欺负么？
这个世界上还有天理么？让我们普通人没有活路啊”
录完之后，瞬间收了鼻涕眼泪，又恶狠狠道“你们要是不把这个小畜生开除！我就曝光你们！”
“没用。”黄波指了指角落的摄像头“有监控
你发网上也行，报治安局也行，是你们找事在先。”

“”
女人脸上一阵青一阵白，嘴唇哆哆嗦嗦的，有趣极了。
以往她仗着泼辣，仗着胡搅蛮缠，总是能得到对自己比较有利的结果；
没想到，这次居然不灵了？
那自己和老公的这顿打，就白挨了？
最重要的还是自己的儿子
办公室内陷入了寂静，只有指骨碎裂的男人压抑的闷哼。
此时，随着一阵脚步声，校长齐达走了进来；
他身后还跟着一个众人熟悉的身影正是周哲！
只见他三步并作两步的跑了进来，哪里还有一点骨折的样子？
“妈！你怎么了？谁打的你？！”
女人的目光看向楚元；
“你踏马的楚元！你敢打我妈！”周哲的眼珠子一下子红了，捏着拳头就要向楚元冲过来。
“够了！”齐达怒喝，一阵令人压抑的气息从他身上浮现而出！
办公室内，似乎有微风渐起，楚元只觉得汗毛直立，仿佛被什么蛮荒凶兽给盯上！
苗俊和黄波的身形也不由自主的站的笔直，似乎随时准备迎敌！
这就是校长的实力么五阶强者！
好在齐达只是为了震慑，气势一放便收；
content_en:
In the martial arts journey, if you don’t advance, you will retreat;
Although Que Yuan Gong can be said to be practiced by all people, it does not mean that the older people get, their strength will gradually become stronger.
On the contrary, for ordinary people who have not gone to a martial arts university and have chosen a variety of careers, their strongest moment is before the college entrance examination.
In the future, whether you are going to college or working, where will you find the time and energy to practice martial arts?
Even if you have the time and the will, martial arts training is still quite expensive;
At the very least, people who don’t get into martial arts universities will basically give up on training because they eat more.
Zhou Zhe's parents were in this situation, so Huang Bo and Miao Jun were not worried at all that the man could hurt Chu Yuan;
They also hate such messy people, but after all, they have the identity of a teacher, so they can't take action personally.
The woman shook her dizzy head, one side of her face swelled up like a dough bun, and she looked at the three people with resentment;
This time Chu Yuan had mastered the power, so her head didn't explode like a watermelon.
As expected, she didn't stop, but she didn't dare to come forward anymore. Instead, she took out her mobile phone and her face changed in a second;
I started crying with runny nose and tears.
"Look at it all! Look at it all!
Chenyang No. 1 Middle School is simply a bandit den!
It wasn't enough that they broke my son's legs, they also beat me as a woman!
Even my husband's hand was broken by them. As ordinary people, are we destined to be bullied like this?
Is there any justice in this world? It leaves us ordinary people with no way to survive.”
After the recording, he immediately suppressed his snot and tears, and said fiercely, "If you don't fire this little beast! I will expose you!"
"It's useless." Huang Bo pointed to the camera in the corner, "There is surveillance.
You can post it online or report it to the Public Security Bureau. You are the first to find trouble. "
""
The woman's face turned blue and white, and her lips trembled, which was very interesting.
In the past, she relied on her aggressiveness and recklessness to always get results that were more beneficial to herself;
Unexpectedly, it didn’t work this time?
So the beating between you and your husband was in vain?
The most important thing is his son
Silence fell in the office, except for the muffled groan of the man with broken finger bones.
At this time, with the sound of footsteps, Principal Qida walked in;
Behind him was a familiar figure, none other than Zhou Zhe!
I saw him running in three steps at a time, and there was still a bit of a broken bone?
"Mom! What's wrong with you? Who hit you?!"
The woman looked at Chu Yuan;
"You're riding a horse, Chu Yuan! How dare you hit my mother!" Zhou Zhe's eyes suddenly turned red, and he clenched his fists and was about to rush towards Chu Yuan.
"Enough!" Zida shouted angrily, and a depressing breath emerged from him!
In the office, a breeze seemed to be picking up, and Chu Yuan felt like his hair stood on end, as if he was being targeted by some wild beast!
Miao Jun and Huang Bo couldn't help but stand upright, as if they were ready to face the enemy at any time!
Is this the strength of the principal, a fifth-level powerhouse!
Fortunately, Qi Da only wanted to intimidate, and his momentum would be suppressed as soon as it was released;
